name: GetSubfoldersInFolder
label: Retrieve Subfolders from Directory
description: Returns a list of subfolder paths within the specified directory.

fields.name: FolderPath
fields.label: Source Folder Path
fields.description: The full path of the directory from which subfolders will be retrieved.

fields.name: IncludeSubfolders
fields.label: Include Nested Subfolders
fields.description: Determines whether to include all nested subdirectories recursively.

fields.name: Subfolders
fields.label: Subfolder List
fields.description: The collection of subfolder paths found in the specified directory.
